description_en: Updates the actions and match conditions of web filtering rules in batches. You can update up to 20 rules at a time. The rule IDs in the list must be unique
description_zh: 批量修改Web过滤规则的动作与匹配条件。单次最多修改20条规则，列表内规则ID不可重复
name: UpdateWebFilterRules

fields.help_en: The type of the match condition. Only URL is supported, which indicates matching by URL
fields.help_zh: 匹配条件的类型。取值仅支持URL，表示按URL匹配
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The URL to match. The value cannot be empty and must not exceed 240 bytes in length. Each Chinese character is counted as 3 bytes. The URL must contain at least one forward slash (/), and the first segment must contain letters, digits, or Chinese characters. The URL cannot contain a protocol header, query parameters, or fragment identifiers. A single asterisk () matches all URLs. If a wildcard is used, only one wildcard is allowed and it must end with /. URLs within the same template must be unique
fields.help_zh: 匹配的URL。不能为空，长度不超过240个字节（中文按3个字节计算）。必须包含至少一个正斜线（/），首个分段需包含字母、数字或中文；不能携带协议头、查询参数或片段标识。单独传入星号（）表示匹配全部URL；使用通配符时最多1个且必须以/结尾。同一模板内URL不可重复
fields.name: values

fields.help_en: The list of match conditions for the rule. The list must contain exactly one condition. After the update, URLs within the same template must be unique
fields.help_zh: 规则的匹配条件列表。必须且只能包含1个条件。修改后同一模板内URL不可重复
fields.name: conditions

fields.help_en:
The action to perform when the rule is matched. Valid values:
Allow: allows the request.
Alert: monitors the request.
Deny: blocks the request
fields.help_zh:
规则命中后执行的动作。取值：
Allow：放行。
Alert：观察。
Deny：拦截
fields.name: rule_action

fields.help_en: The ID of the web filtering rule to be updated. The rule must exist within the current Alibaba Cloud account
fields.help_zh: 要修改的Web过滤规则ID。必须为当前阿里云账号下已存在的规则
fields.name: web_filter_rule_id

parameters.help_en: The list of web filtering rules to be updated. You can specify up to 20 rules at a time. The rule IDs in the list must be unique
parameters.help_zh: 待修改的Web过滤规则列表。单次最多传入20条规则，列表内规则ID不可重复
parameters.name: rules
